carousel.ne301.tagline.message: New low-power Edge AI camera based on STM32N6

carousel.ne301.desc.message: High-performance Cortex-M55 + NPU architecture, supporting local real-time inference. Modular design adaptable to various lenses and sensors, ideal for computer vision and AIoT nodes.

carousel.ne101.tagline.message: Ultra-low power visual sensor node based on ESP32-S3

carousel.ne101.desc.message: Designed for battery-powered scenarios, supporting Wi-Fi/Cat.1/Wi-Fi HaLow connectivity. Minimalist architecture, millisecond wake-up capture from deep sleep, suitable for outdoor monitoring and meter reading.

carousel.ng4500.tagline.message: High-performance edge computing gateway based on NVIDIA Jetson

carousel.ng4500.desc.message: Delivers 21~100+ TOPS computing power, supporting multi-channel video analysis and LLM edge deployment. Rich interfaces (CAN/232/485) empowering complex industrial and automotive AI applications.

carousel.neomind.tagline.message: Rust + React edge AI platform · Out-of-the-box IoT + AI integration

carousel.neomind.desc.message: Device management, real-time dashboards, rule engine, AI Agent, extension ecosystem, and message notifications — all built in. Supports MQTT/Webhook/BLE protocols. Can be deployed standalone or as the companion software for CamThink hardware.

carousel.ne503.tagline.message: Hailo-15H based 20 TOPS 4K edge AI smart camera

carousel.ne503.desc.message: Hailo-15H SoC + 20 TOPS NPU + Sony IMX678 4K imaging. Containerized app deployment, multi-model concurrent inference, RTSP/Event output. IP67 + PoE integrated delivery for vision applications and edge AI development.
